# setup
## libraries
```{r}
# ── packages ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(zoo)
library(pracma)
library(arrow)           # read_feather / write_feather
arrow::set_cpu_count(4)

# ── project functions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
source('../functions/params.R')
source('../functions/theme.R')
source('../functions/general.R')
source('../functions/r_general.R')
source('../functions/stats.R')        # tidy_cormatrix (Step 7)
source('../functions/analysis_peth.R') # combine_session_fp, combine_session_fp_bl (Step 7)
source('../functions/r_head_fixed_processing.R')
source('../functions/compile_data.R')
source('../logs_and_keys/key_local_directories.R')
```

## directories
```{r}
# ── local session store ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
dir_localdata_sessions        <- '../data/sessions/'
dir_sessions_combined_subject <- '../data/sessions_combined_subject/'

# ── network: TDT fiber photometry server ─────────────────────────────────────
# dir_tdt set in key_local_directories.R
dir_tdt_raw       <- str_c(dir_tdt, 'data_raw/')
dir_tdt_extracted <- str_c(dir_tdt, 'data_extracted/')
dir_tdt_processed <- str_c(dir_tdt, 'data_processed/')

# ── network: NPM fiber photometry server ─────────────────────────────────────
# dir_npm set in key_local_directories.R
dir_npm_raw       <- str_c(dir_npm, 'data_raw/')
dir_npm_extracted <- str_c(dir_npm, 'data_extracted/')
dir_npm_processed <- str_c(dir_npm, 'data_processed/')

# ── arduino behavioral data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# dir_arduino_raw set in key_local_directories.R
dir_arduino_raw_local  <- '../data/arduino/raw/'
dir_arduino_extraction <- '../data/arduino/extracted/'
dir_arduino_processed  <- '../data/arduino/processed/'
```

## logs / keys
```{r}
# ── analysis inclusion / exclusion log (local xlsx) ──────────────────────────
# sheets: subjects | fp | experiments
log_analysis_subjects <- read_xlsx('../logs_and_keys/log_data_analysis.xlsx', sheet = 'subjects',    na = c('NA', ''))
log_analysis_fp       <- read_xlsx('../logs_and_keys/log_data_analysis.xlsx', sheet = 'fp',          na = c('NA', ''))
log_analysis_exp      <- read_xlsx('../logs_and_keys/log_data_analysis.xlsx', sheet = 'experiments', na = c('NA', ''))
```

```{r}
# ── session / hardware logs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

# arduino event key
key_events          <- read.csv('../logs_and_keys/key_events_arduino.csv')

# multi-spout behavioral sessions and spout identity
log_data_multi      <- read.csv('../logs_and_keys/log_behavior_headfixed_multispout_sessions.csv', na.strings = c('NA', ''))
log_multi_spout_ids <- read.csv('../logs_and_keys/log_behavior_headfixed_multispout_soutids.csv',  na.strings = c('NA', ''))

# fiber photometry hardware logs
log_tdt             <- read.csv('../logs_and_keys/log_fiberphotometry_tdt.csv', na.strings = c('', 'NA'))
log_npm             <- read.csv('../logs_and_keys/log_fiberphotometry_npm.csv', na.strings = c('', 'NA'))

# fiber placement coordinates
log_placements      <- read.csv('../logs_and_keys/log_fiber_placements.csv', na.strings = c('', 'NA'))
```


# execution
## behavior
```{r}
# ── step 1: copy raw arduino files from network to local ─────────────────────
manual_blocknames <- log_analysis_fp %>% 
  left_join(log_analysis_subjects %>% select(subject, remove)) %>%
  filter(remove == 0) %>%
  pull(blockname)

import_arduino(manual_blocknames, dir_arduino_raw, dir_arduino_raw_local, overwrite = 0)
```

```{r, message = FALSE}
# ── step 2: extract serial output and process multi-spout behavior ────────────

# extract raw arduino serial data into event / param / param_dynamic tables
extract_serial_output(
  dir_arduino_raw_local,
  key_events,
  dir_arduino_extraction,
  manual_experiments = NA,
  manual_blocknames  = manual_blocknames,
  file_format_output = 'csv',
  overwrite = 0)

# process extracted data into trial-level behavioral summaries
process_multi_spout(
  dir_arduino_extraction,
  dir_arduino_processed,
  log_data_multi,
  log_multi_spout_ids,
  file_format_output    = 'csv',
  manual_fns            = manual_blocknames,
  overwrite             = 0,
  time_bin_width        = 100,
  time_bin_range        = c(0, 3000),
  session_trial_width   = 10,
  session_trial_range   = c(0, 100))
```


## fiber photometry
```{r}
# ── build session import key ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# join log_analysis_fp (session-level inclusion flags) with log_analysis_exp
# (experiment-level metadata including data directories)
import_key <- log_analysis_fp %>%
  select(experiment, subject, blockname, procedure, exclude, deprivation, imaging) %>%
  left_join(log_analysis_exp, by = "experiment") %>%
  filter(is.na(exclude) | exclude != 1)           # drop excluded sessions

# multi-spout sessions only (baseline, fa_, acq excluded from paper)
import_key_multi <- import_key %>%
  filter(str_detect(procedure, 'multi'))
```

```{r}
# ── step 3: copy behavioral and FP data into per-session local folders ────────
# output: ../data/sessions/<blockname>/<blockname>_*.csv/.feather

locally_save_multispout_data_behavior(import_key_multi, dir_localdata_sessions, overwrite = 0)
locally_save_multispout_data_fp_peth(import_key_multi, dir_localdata_sessions, dir_tdt, dir_npm, overwrite = 0)
```

```{r}
# ── step 3b: copy and trim baseline FP streams into per-session local folders ─
# blockname_baselines: sessions where the baseline was recorded as a separate file
blockname_baselines <- c('2022_06_09_aaw08', '2022_06_09_aaw09', '2023_04_06_aaw17')

locally_save_multispout_data_fp_baseline(import_key_multi, dir_localdata_sessions, dir_tdt, dir_npm,
                                         blockname_baselines = blockname_baselines, overwrite = 0)
```

```{r}
# ── step 4: preprocess FP peri-event time series ─────────────────────────────
# computes z-score, assigns brain-region IDs, and saves preprocessed feathers
multispout_preprocess_fp_peth(import_key_multi, dir_localdata_sessions, log_tdt, log_npm, overwrite = 0)
```

```{r}
# ── step 4b: preprocess baseline FP streams ──────────────────────────────────
# z-scores baseline signal and computes lha_ratio
multispout_preprocess_fp_baseline(import_key_multi, dir_localdata_sessions, log_tdt, log_npm)
```

```{r}
# ── step 5: compute per-session summary statistics ───────────────────────────
summarise_sessions(import_key_multi, dir_localdata_sessions, overwrite = 0)
```

```{r}
# ── step 6: compute FP signal quality metrics ────────────────────────────────
# flags sessions / regions with poor signal for downstream filtering
get_signal_quality_control(dir_localdata_sessions, overwrite = 0)
```


## inter-regional correlation
```{r}
# ── step 7 setup: load QC metrics and define excluded subjects ────────────────
# requires quality_metrics.csv files written by step 6
fns_qc_metrics      <- list.files(dir_localdata_sessions, pattern = 'quality_metrics.csv', recursive = T, full.names = T)
combined_qc_metrics <- bind_rows(lapply(fns_qc_metrics, read.csv))
```

```{r}
# ── step 7a: STR inter-regional correlation ───────────────────────────────────
# subjects with all 6 STR fibers (nac, nac_shelllat, nac_corr, dms, dls, ts)
# reads: data/sessions/*_streams_baseline_preprocessed.feather
#        data/sessions/*_streams_peth_preprocessed.feather
# writes: data/sessions_combined_subject/{subject}_{set_id}/corelation/streams_*.csv/.feather

str_regions <- c('nac', 'nac_shelllat', 'nac_corr', 'dms', 'dls', 'ts')

blocknames_6fibers <- log_analysis_fp %>%
  filter(is.na(exclude) | exclude != 1) %>%
  left_join(log_npm %>% select(blockname, region), by = 'blockname') %>%
  left_join(combined_qc_metrics %>% select(blockname, region, exclude_poor_signal),
            by = c('blockname', 'region')) %>%
  filter(exclude_poor_signal == 0 | is.na(exclude_poor_signal)) %>%
  select(-exclude_poor_signal) %>%
  format_regions('region', key_regions) %>%
  filter_placements('exclude_da_consumption') %>%
  group_by(blockname) %>%
  mutate(region_count = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(region_count == 6) %>%
  get_set_id() %>%
  select(subject, blockname, procedure, set_id) %>%
  unique() %>%
  filter(!is.na(set_id))

subject_x_set <- blocknames_6fibers %>%
  select(subject, set_id) %>%
  unique()

print(str_c('Step 7a: ', nrow(subject_x_set), ' subject × set_id combinations'))

for (n_subject_x_set in seq(1, nrow(subject_x_set))) {

  loop_subject_x_set <- subject_x_set[n_subject_x_set, ]
  print(str_c(' ~ ', loop_subject_x_set$subject, '_', loop_subject_x_set$set_id,
              ' [', n_subject_x_set, ' / ', nrow(subject_x_set), ']'))

  loop_dir_output <- str_c(dir_sessions_combined_subject,
                           loop_subject_x_set$subject, '_', loop_subject_x_set$set_id,
                           '/corelation/')
  if (!dir.exists(loop_dir_output)) dir.create(loop_dir_output, recursive = T)

  loop_blocknames <- blocknames_6fibers %>%
    filter(subject == loop_subject_x_set$subject, set_id == loop_subject_x_set$set_id) %>%
    pull(blockname)

  # baseline: load, pivot wide, save feather
  df_bl <- combine_session_fp_bl(loop_blocknames, dir_localdata_sessions) %>%
    mutate(subject = loop_subject_x_set$subject, set_id = loop_subject_x_set$set_id) %>%
    select(blockname, subject, set_id, time, region, zscore) %>%
    spread(region, zscore)

  df_bl %>% write_feather(str_c(loop_dir_output, 'streams_baseline_cor_data.feather'))

  # peth: load, filter lick trials, pivot wide, save feather
  df_peth <- combine_session_fp(loop_blocknames, dir_localdata_sessions) %>%
    mutate(subject = loop_subject_x_set$subject, set_id = loop_subject_x_set$set_id) %>%
    filter(trial_lick == 1) %>%
    filter(time_rel > -3, time_rel <= 9)

  n_sessions <- df_peth %>% filter(time_rel == 0) %>% select(blockname) %>% unique() %>% nrow()
  n_trial    <- df_peth %>% filter(time_rel == 0) %>% select(blockname, trial_num) %>% unique() %>% nrow()
  tibble(n_sessions = n_sessions, n_trial = n_trial, filt_lick = 1) %>%
    write_csv(str_c(loop_dir_output, 'streams_peth_cor_meta.csv'))

  df_peth <- df_peth %>%
    select(blockname, subject, set_id, trial_num, solution, time_rel, region, zscore_blsub) %>%
    spread(region, zscore_blsub)

  df_peth %>% write_feather(str_c(loop_dir_output, 'streams_peth_cor_data.feather'))

  # skip subjects with too few trials
  trial_counts <- df_peth %>%
    select(all_of(c(str_regions, 'subject', 'set_id', 'solution', 'time_rel'))) %>%
    group_by(subject, set_id, solution, time_rel) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    pull(count)

  if (min(trial_counts) > 4) {

    # baseline correlation matrix
    tidy_cormatrix(df_bl, str_regions, c('subject', 'set_id')) %>%
      format_regions('var_y', key_regions) %>%
      format_regions('var_x', key_regions) %>%
      write_csv(str_c(loop_dir_output, 'streams_baseline_corr.csv'))

    # peth correlation — per timepoint
    tidy_cormatrix(df_peth, str_regions, c('subject', 'set_id', 'time_rel')) %>%
      format_regions('var_y', key_regions) %>%
      format_regions('var_x', key_regions) %>%
      write_csv(str_c(loop_dir_output, 'streams_peth_corr_timerel.csv'))

    # peth correlation — pre / sustained / post windows
    df_peth %>%
      mutate(time_rel_bin = case_when(
        time_rel > -2 & time_rel < 0 ~ 'Pre',
        time_rel >= 1 & time_rel < 3 ~ 'Sustained',
        time_rel >= 6 & time_rel < 8 ~ 'Post'
      )) %>%
      filter(!is.na(time_rel_bin)) %>%
      tidy_cormatrix(str_regions, c('subject', 'set_id', 'time_rel_bin')) %>%
      format_regions('var_y', key_regions) %>%
      format_regions('var_x', key_regions) %>%
      write_csv(str_c(loop_dir_output, 'streams_peth_corr_windows.csv'))

    # peth correlation — per solution × timepoint
    tidy_cormatrix(df_peth, str_regions, c('subject', 'set_id', 'solution', 'time_rel')) %>%
      format_regions('var_y', key_regions) %>%
      format_regions('var_x', key_regions) %>%
      write_csv(str_c(loop_dir_output, 'streams_peth_corr_timerel_sol.csv'))

  } else {
    print('  ** TOO FEW TRIALS FOR CORRELATION — SKIPPING **')
  }
}
```

```{r}
# ── step 7b: LHA/STR inter-regional correlation ───────────────────────────────
# subjects with simultaneous LHA + STR recordings (experiment == 'acr')
# requires 5 physical fiber sites: LHA, nac, dms, dls, ts
# (LHA later expands into 3 derived signals — lha_gaba/lha_glut/lha_ratio — via format_regions())
# reads / writes same pattern as step 7a; files prefixed 'lhastr_'

lhastr_regions <- c('lha_gaba', 'lha_glut', 'lha_ratio', 'nac', 'dms', 'dls', 'ts')

blocknames_lhastrcor <- log_analysis_fp %>%
  filter(is.na(exclude) | exclude != 1) %>%
  filter(experiment == 'acr') %>%
  left_join(log_npm %>% select(blockname, region), by = 'blockname') %>%
  left_join(combined_qc_metrics %>% select(blockname, region, exclude_poor_signal),
            by = c('blockname', 'region')) %>%
  filter(exclude_poor_signal == 0 | is.na(exclude_poor_signal)) %>%
  select(-exclude_poor_signal) %>%
  format_regions('region', key_regions) %>%
  mutate(region = as.character(region)) %>%
  mutate(region = ifelse(is.na(region), 'LHA', region)) %>%
  left_join(log_placements %>% select(subject, region = target, exclude_da_consumption),
            by = c('region', 'subject')) %>%
  filter(exclude_da_consumption != 1) %>%
  select(-exclude_da_consumption) %>%
  group_by(blockname) %>%
  mutate(region_count = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(region_count == 5) %>%
  get_set_id() %>%
  select(subject, blockname, procedure, set_id) %>%
  unique() %>%
  filter(set_id %in% c('wrnacl', 'wrsuc', 'frsuc'))

subject_x_set <- blocknames_lhastrcor %>%
  select(subject, set_id) %>%
  unique()

print(str_c('Step 7b: ', nrow(subject_x_set), ' subject × set_id combinations'))

for (n_subject_x_set in seq(1, nrow(subject_x_set))) {

  loop_subject_x_set <- subject_x_set[n_subject_x_set, ]
  print(str_c(' ~ ', loop_subject_x_set$subject, '_', loop_subject_x_set$set_id,
              ' [', n_subject_x_set, ' / ', nrow(subject_x_set), ']'))

  loop_dir_output <- str_c(dir_sessions_combined_subject,
                           loop_subject_x_set$subject, '_', loop_subject_x_set$set_id,
                           '/corelation/')
  if (!dir.exists(loop_dir_output)) dir.create(loop_dir_output, recursive = T)

  loop_blocknames <- blocknames_lhastrcor %>%
    filter(subject == loop_subject_x_set$subject, set_id == loop_subject_x_set$set_id) %>%
    pull(blockname)

  # baseline: load, pivot wide, save feather
  df_bl <- combine_session_fp_bl(loop_blocknames, dir_localdata_sessions) %>%
    mutate(subject = loop_subject_x_set$subject, set_id = loop_subject_x_set$set_id) %>%
    select(blockname, subject, set_id, time, region, zscore) %>%
    spread(region, zscore)

  df_bl %>% write_feather(str_c(loop_dir_output, 'lhastr_streams_baseline_cor_data.feather'))

  # peth: load, filter lick trials, pivot wide, save feather
  df_peth <- combine_session_fp(loop_blocknames, dir_localdata_sessions) %>%
    mutate(subject = loop_subject_x_set$subject, set_id = loop_subject_x_set$set_id) %>%
    filter(trial_lick == 1) %>%
    filter(time_rel > -3, time_rel <= 9)

  n_sessions <- df_peth %>% filter(time_rel == 0) %>% select(blockname) %>% unique() %>% nrow()
  n_trial    <- df_peth %>% filter(time_rel == 0) %>% select(blockname, trial_num) %>% unique() %>% nrow()
  tibble(n_sessions = n_sessions, n_trial = n_trial, filt_lick = 1) %>%
    write_csv(str_c(loop_dir_output, 'lhastr_streams_peth_cor_meta.csv'))

  df_peth <- df_peth %>%
    select(blockname, subject, set_id, trial_num, solution, time_rel, region, zscore_blsub) %>%
    spread(region, zscore_blsub)

  df_peth %>% write_feather(str_c(loop_dir_output, 'lhastr_streams_peth_cor_data.feather'))

  # skip subjects with too few trials
  trial_counts <- df_peth %>%
    select(all_of(c(lhastr_regions, 'subject', 'set_id', 'solution', 'time_rel'))) %>%
    group_by(subject, set_id, solution, time_rel) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    pull(count)

  if (min(trial_counts) > 4) {

    # baseline correlation matrix
    tidy_cormatrix(df_bl, lhastr_regions, c('subject', 'set_id')) %>%
      format_regions('var_y', key_regions) %>%
      format_regions('var_x', key_regions) %>%
      write_csv(str_c(loop_dir_output, 'lhastr_streams_baseline_corr.csv'))

    # peth correlation — per timepoint
    tidy_cormatrix(df_peth, lhastr_regions, c('subject', 'set_id', 'time_rel')) %>%
      format_regions('var_y', key_regions) %>%
      format_regions('var_x', key_regions) %>%
      write_csv(str_c(loop_dir_output, 'lhastr_streams_peth_corr_timerel.csv'))

    # peth correlation — pre / sustained / post windows
    df_peth %>%
      mutate(time_rel_bin = case_when(
        time_rel > -2 & time_rel < 0 ~ 'Pre',
        time_rel >= 1 & time_rel < 3 ~ 'Sustained',
        time_rel >= 6 & time_rel < 8 ~ 'Post'
      )) %>%
      filter(!is.na(time_rel_bin)) %>%
      tidy_cormatrix(lhastr_regions, c('subject', 'set_id', 'time_rel_bin')) %>%
      format_regions('var_y', key_regions) %>%
      format_regions('var_x', key_regions) %>%
      write_csv(str_c(loop_dir_output, 'lhastr_streams_peth_corr_windows.csv'))

    # peth correlation — per solution × timepoint
    tidy_cormatrix(df_peth, lhastr_regions, c('subject', 'set_id', 'solution', 'time_rel')) %>%
      format_regions('var_y', key_regions) %>%
      format_regions('var_x', key_regions) %>%
      write_csv(str_c(loop_dir_output, 'lhastr_streams_peth_corr_timerel_sol.csv'))

  } else {
    print('  ** TOO FEW TRIALS FOR CORRELATION — SKIPPING **')
  }
}
```
